--8<-- [start:debug_sig]
Debug(+Msg)
Debug(+Logger, +Msg)
--8<-- [end:debug_sig]

--8<-- [start:info_sig]
Info(+Msg)
Info(+Logger, +Msg)
--8<-- [end:info_sig]

--8<-- [start:warning_sig]
Warning(+Msg)
Warning(+Logger, +Msg)
--8<-- [end:warning_sig]

--8<-- [start:error_sig]
Error(+Msg)
Error(+Logger, +Msg)
--8<-- [end:error_sig]

--8<-- [start:critical_sig]
Critical(+Msg)
Critical(+Logger, +Msg)
--8<-- [end:critical_sig]

--8<-- [start:log_sig]
Log(+Logger, +Level, +Msg)
--8<-- [end:log_sig]

--8<-- [start:fstring_example]
Info(L, f"User {USERID} logged in from {IP}")
--8<-- [end:fstring_example]

--8<-- [start:get_logger_sig]
GetLogger(-Logger)
GetLogger(+Name, -Logger)
--8<-- [end:get_logger_sig]

--8<-- [start:set_level_sig]
SetLevel(+Logger, +Level)
--8<-- [end:set_level_sig]

--8<-- [start:get_level_sig]
GetLevel(+Logger, -Level)
--8<-- [end:get_level_sig]

--8<-- [start:is_enabled_for_sig]
IsEnabledFor(+Logger, +Level)
--8<-- [end:is_enabled_for_sig]

--8<-- [start:stream_handler_sig]
StreamHandler(+StreamName, -Handler)
--8<-- [end:stream_handler_sig]

--8<-- [start:file_handler_sig]
FileHandler(+Path, -Handler)
--8<-- [end:file_handler_sig]

--8<-- [start:set_formatter_sig]
SetFormatter(+Handler, +FormatString)
--8<-- [end:set_formatter_sig]

--8<-- [start:add_handler_sig]
AddHandler(+Logger, +Handler)
--8<-- [end:add_handler_sig]

--8<-- [start:remove_handler_sig]
RemoveHandler(+Logger, +Handler)
--8<-- [end:remove_handler_sig]

--8<-- [start:basic_config_sig]
BasicConfig(+Opts)
--8<-- [end:basic_config_sig]

--8<-- [start:basic_usage]
-import_from(log, [GetLogger, Info, Warning, SetLevel])

Init(L) <- (
    GetLogger("myapp", L),
    SetLevel(L, "info"),
    Info(L, "Application started")
)

ProcessItem(L, ITEM) <- (
    ITEM > 0,
    Info(L, f"Processing item {ITEM}")
)
ProcessItem(L, ITEM) <- (
    ITEM =< 0,
    Warning(L, f"Skipping invalid item {ITEM}")
)
--8<-- [end:basic_usage]

--8<-- [start:custom_handler]
-import_from(log, [
    GetLogger, Info, SetLevel,
    StreamHandler, FileHandler, SetFormatter, AddHandler
])

SetupLogging(L) <- (
    GetLogger("myapp", L),
    SetLevel(L, "debug"),
    FileHandler("/var/log/myapp.log", FH),
    SetFormatter(FH, "%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s"),
    AddHandler(L, FH),
    StreamHandler("stderr", SH),
    SetFormatter(SH, "%(levelname)s: %(message)s"),
    AddHandler(L, SH)
)
--8<-- [end:custom_handler]

--8<-- [start:logger_hierarchy]
-import_from(log, [GetLogger, Info, SetLevel])

Setup <- (
    GetLogger("myapp", PARENT),
    SetLevel(PARENT, "info"),
    GetLogger("myapp.db", DBLOG),
    SetLevel(DBLOG, "debug"),
    Info(DBLOG, "DB logger inherits parent's handlers")
)
--8<-- [end:logger_hierarchy]
